_note: Root package.json of an A1/A3 app: delegates to api/ and ui/ only. A2 (API only) has no root file, use the backend template directly.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix ui install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix ui run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix api run lint && npm --prefix ui run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix ui test
scripts.docker:up: docker compose --env-file .env.docker --profile db --profile api --profile ui up -d
